_comment: The shape of THIS project. Version it: whoever works here must use the same providers. Credentials do NOT belong here — they are the plugin's userConfig, per user.

board._sync: Optional. A secondary view (a board, a dashboard) to realign after every state change. It is NOT the source of truth — the tracker is. If this command fails the loop SAYS SO and carries on: a stale view is an annoyance, a stalled loop is a blocker.

build._tiers: Optional, and only needed when part of the gate CANNOT run everywhere. A gate that skips a tier silently reads as green: that is how a defect survives for months. Declare every conditional tier here; preflight reports which are available and which are not, and the loop must name the missing ones at the regression gate instead of calling a partial run green.

_stack: Default profile, relative to the repository root (e.g. .agents/harness/stacks/swift-spm.md). An absolute path into a home directory makes the manifest useless on another machine and for anyone else. Needed only when the roster uses the generic role agents.
_stacks_by_component: Optional, for a multi-stack repo. Maps the label identifying a part of the product to the profile the role agents receive. A value of `null` means: no stack, and therefore no implementer role to spawn — the case for prose and schemas. A ticket without that label does not enter the loop: ask for it rather than guessing.
